text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — opened PR #4827 to add Rust + Java snippet parity for the Optimize toolkit docs (batching, KV prefetch, quant profiles). Need a quick review and a tiny link fix before we merge today.

Sam: Nice, thanks. What exactly needs review?

Maria: Two things: 1) a broken console link (points to /optimize/kv-prefetch but should be /console/optimize/kv-prefetch), 2) the Rust snippet has an accidental backtick inside the fenced block which breaks rendering. Also added a short microbenchmark note under "when to use prefetch" (3–5% latency win for shortseq workloads).

Raj: I can take the snippet formatting and link fix. Will also sanity-run the examples locally. Which sample corpus did you use for the microbenchmark?

Maria: Used the small-seq english/small-corpus set (~/samples/shortseq-1k). Bench command in PR description:

```bash
# run microbench (docker)
docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/samples:/data optimize-bench:latest \
  --model redwood-local/llama-13b-quant --input /data/shortseq-1k --mode kv-prefetch \
  --batch 8 --iters 100
```

Maria: Results pasted in the PR — median p95 reduced by ~4% with KV prefetch + small batch tuning (batch 8), quan profiles unchanged.

Emily: I can smoke-test the SDK snippets in Java this afternoon. Which package name did you use for the Java sample?

Maria: `ai.redwood.optimize` — included a Maven snippet and a tiny code example:

```java
OptimizeClient client = OptimizeClient.builder().apiKey(System.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY")).build();
BatchRequest req = BatchRequest.builder().model("redwood/13b-q").batchSize(8).build();
client.batch(req);
```

DocsBot: PR 4827 — automerge blocked: missing i18n header on docs/en/optimize/kv-prefetch.md (check: l10n-checker).

Maria: Ah — missed the i18n frontmatter. I'll add it in a follow-up commit.

Raj: Link fix done and pushed as commit 3 (https://github.com/redwood/opt-docs/pull/4827/commits/3). Also removed the stray backtick in the Rust block. Confirmed rendering locally.

Sam: Thanks Raj. Emily — can you confirm the Java snippet compiles against 0.9.2 SDK?

Emily: Compiles fine but found one import mismatch (provoked by sample package). Pushed a tiny tweak to the PR that updates the import and adds a one-line comment about thread-safety.

Maria: Great. After DocsBot l10n pass, can we fast-track this? It's small and unblocks a few internal examples. I'd like to merge before EOD.

DocsBot: l10n-checker: docs/en/optimize/kv-prefetch.md — frontmatter added by Maria in commit 4, checks passed.

Sam: Looks green to me. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

Raj: Approved and merged. :tada:

Maria: Awesome — will follow up with a short note in the release notes about the Rust/Java parity and the microbenchmark numbers. Thanks all! :rocket:
